messages:
micah: Heads-up — CI perf test fanned out on canary: rtf-ctb token/sec down ~32% since merge of PR #4821. Seeing queueing spikes and long drain times.
ci-bot: perf/canary-rtf failed: token_rate_drop >= 25% (regression) — job 7621.
micah: Attaching quick flame and tail of scheduler logs: http://perf.internal/flames/2191234567 and s3://redwood-perf/ctb/2191234567/sched.log
micah: Flame shows kernel_selection path hanging around 12–18ms more per op, and memcpy time increased.
anya: Oof. Any recent kernel-selection changes in that PR?
samir: PR #4821 touched kernel policy thresholds and added a new fallback branch for small batches. Could be misrouting to memcpy-heavy path.
micah: Here's a shortened profiler snippet: ```
# top hotspots
kernel_select()              18.2ms   +11.3ms
memcpy_device_to_host        12.0ms   +9.8ms
ctb_drain_loop               45.6ms   +20.4ms
```
jia: Also seeing KV cache warmup drop in hitrate on canary traces — that amplifies small-batch effects. Are we invalidating prefixes anywhere?
leo: I ran a lightweight bisect locally across the last 6 commits. When I checkout commit `a1b2c3f` (pre-PR), token/sec is back to baseline. With `d4e5f6g` (post-PR) we hit the regression.
micah: Great — can you paste the exact git range you used?
leo: Range `a1b2c3f..d4e5f6g`, narrowed to `dca9b7f` which flips the kernel routing predicate for short sequences.
samir: That predicate was trying to prefer the fast fused kernel for seq_len <= 32, but I guess the new check misclassifies some contexts so they go to a generic memcpy path.
anya: If it's misclassifying, we should hold rollout. @deploy-bot can you pin canary back to `a1b2c3f`? :lock:
deploy-bot: rollback requested by anya — creating rollback deployment to `a1b2c3f` in canary. Job 7629 queued.
ci-bot: NOTE: perf CI also ran a microbenchmark for kernel selection. Regression reproduced on ubuntu-gpu-perf image. Artifacts: http://ci.internal/artifacts/7621/report.html
micah: For triage: two vectors — kernel_selection misroute + KV cache cold path increasing small-batch fraction. Both multiply token/sec loss.
jia: Quick mitigation ideas: 1) revert kernel predicate change (safe) 2) force preferred kernel choice override in runtime flag for canary 3) warm KV cache via synthetic prefix caching during startup.
leo: I can push a revert PR for the predicate right now (short). If we want the flag I can add `--force-kernel=fused` to the canary config.
samir: I'd prefer revert + add a transient metric to count kernel routing decisions so we can watch distribution.
micah: Agreed. Revert + metric. @benchbot can you run a short 5m token/sec run after revert?
benchbot: scheduled bench job 7635 (5m, canary) — will post results when done.
anya: Also let's capture a KV cache hit-rate heatmap for the same window pre/post revert. Jia can you wire that?
jia: On it. I'll add a one-off trace capture for `kv.hitrate` + `ctb.batch_size` to the canary collection.
micah: Thanks — timeline: leo pushes revert, deploy-bot rolls canary back, benchbot runs bench, we check metrics/heatmap. If good, we lift hold and rework predicate in follow-up.
leo: Revert PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4830 — patch removes the new predicate and restores previous kernel routing.
leo: Deploying revert to canary now.
deploy-bot: deploy/revert to `a1b2c3f` started — canary update job 7630.
ci-bot: Parallel: triggered CI perf microbench for revert commit. Job 7631.
benchbot: bench job 7635 completed — token/sec back to +3% of baseline (within noise). Report: http://bench.internal/7635/result.html
micah: Nice, looks like revert fixed most of the drop.
samir: I'll follow up with a more robust predicate that uses both seq_len and kv_hitrate estimate to avoid misrouting when cache is cold. I'll add a unit test that simulates cold cache sequences.
anya: Postmortem action items: 1) add kernel routing metric 2) add gating perf test in CI for small-batch rtf 3) add KV warmup doc for production canaries.
micah: +1. Thanks everyone — keeping rollout on hold until we re-land with safety checks. :thumbsup:
jia: Logged a rollout-blocker ticket: RD-PLAT-1129 linking PR 4830 and perf artifacts.
micah: Closing loop here once RD-PLAT-1129 is updated with final postmortem and timing.
